parsed.name: TCP/IP网络连接适配器
parsed.description: 非物理软件组件，用于实验控制软件通过套接字与仪器或网络服务建立TCP/IP通信。它负责打开和关闭连接、监听传入数据、发送与接收消息，以及检查连接是否仍然可用。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component that enables laboratory control software to communicate with instruments or network services over a TCP/IP socket. It handles opening and closing the connection, listening for incoming data, transmitting and receiving messages, and checking whether the connection is still available.

actions.description: 监听连接中的新数据并将其写入接收缓冲区。
actions.description_en: Listen for new data on the connection and place it into the receive buffer.

actions.description: 检查TCP/IP套接字连接是否处于打开状态。
actions.description_en: Check whether the TCP/IP socket connection is open.
Send a message through the TCP/IP socket.

actions.description: 从接收缓冲区读取通过TCP/IP连接收到的数据。
actions.description_en: Read data received through the TCP/IP connection from the receive buffer.
